title: Post-Surgical & Chronic Wound Care Nursing
subtitle: Registered nurse home visits for sterile dressing changes and wound recovery
author: Bouul Health Team
problemHeadline: Improper home wound care leads to severe post-operative infections and delayed healing
problemBody: Changing complex surgical dressings without sterile equipment risks hospital readmission.
bouulSolution: SANC registered home nurse arrives with sterile dressing kits and antiseptic solutions
Provides wound measurement, debridement assessment, and healing progress tracking
Escrow holds funds until the nursing visit and care report are logged
aiPromptExample: Need post-op wound care: 'Surgical wound dressing change needed for hip replacement recovery.'
aiDiagnosisOutput: Assessment: Wound clean, zero exudate signs. Treatment: Sterile saline rinse and protective foam pad application. Escrow: R550.
escrowGuarantee: Funds released after nurse submits logged visit note and patient signs off.
pirbStandard: SANC (South African Nursing Council) Registered Professional Nurse.

articleSections.heading: Sterile Protocol Standards
articleSections.body: Nurses adhere to SANC infection control guidelines using single-use sterile field packs.

articleSections.heading: Physician Report Sync
articleSections.body: Healing progress notes and photos are formatted for your attending surgeon's review.

title: Post-Hospitalization Rehabilitation Nursing
subtitle: Dedicated nursing assistance following major surgery or hospital discharge
author: Bouul Health Team
problemHeadline: Discharge from hospital without professional home nursing support causes high anxiety
problemBody: Patients struggling with mobility, drain management, and pain meds often experience avoidable complications.
bouulSolution: Continuous 4-hour or 12-hour nursing shifts tailored to recovery requirements
Monitoring of vital signs, surgical drains, urinary catheters, and medication timing
Escrow protection for hourly nursing care packages
aiPromptExample: Book recovery nurse: 'Need 8-hour day nursing for mom following abdominal surgery.'
aiDiagnosisOutput: Schedule: 08:00 to 16:00. Care Plan: Vital monitoring q2h, drain measurement, pain med admin. Escrow: R1,400.
escrowGuarantee: Escrow released per shift after patient/family approval.
pirbStandard: SANC Professional Nursing Standard & Resuscitation Certified.

articleSections.heading: Vital Sign Surveillance
articleSections.body: Nurses monitor BP, oxygen saturation, and temperature to catch early signs of infection.

articleSections.heading: Mobility Assistance
articleSections.body: Safe transfer techniques assist patients with gentle post-op ambulation to prevent DVT.

title: Geriatric Medication & IV Administration
subtitle: Professional administration of complex medications, injections, and IV drips at home
author: Bouul Health Team
problemHeadline: Missed doses or incorrect injection techniques lead to dangerous health destabilization
problemBody: Elderly patients with multiple prescriptions frequently struggle with complex dosing schedules.
bouulSolution: Registered nurse visits to set up pill-minders, administer insulin, or inject prescribed meds
IV hydration and antibiotic infusion monitoring under doctor direction
Escrow holds payment until medication log is verified
aiPromptExample: Schedule med admin: 'Daily insulin injection and vitals check for diabetic parent.'
aiDiagnosisOutput: Visit Type: Daily Med Check. Admin: Insulin + Glucose check. Escrow: R400/visit.
escrowGuarantee: Escrow released daily upon verified med log entry.
pirbStandard: SANC Registered Nurse & Dispensing License Compliant.

articleSections.heading: Diabetic Management Protocol
articleSections.body: Precise blood glucose tracking prior to insulin administration ensures safe glycemic control.

articleSections.heading: Sharps Safety
articleSections.body: Used needles are disposed of in SABS-compliant biohazard sharps containers.

title: Postnatal Mother & Newborn Care Nursing
subtitle: Certified midwife and baby nurse support for new moms and infants
author: Bouul Health Team
problemHeadline: The first weeks with a newborn can feel overwhelming without expert medical guidance
problemBody: New mothers face lactation challenges, infant jaundice concerns, and sleep deprivation.
bouulSolution: Home visits by certified midwives for infant weight checks and breastfeeding guidance
Umbilical cord care, bath demonstration, and maternal recovery monitoring
Escrow protected single visits or 1-week night nurse packages
aiPromptExample: Book baby nurse: 'Need midwife visit for newborn weight check and latching assistance.'
aiDiagnosisOutput: Visit Plan: Newborn physical check, weight measurement, mother lactation coaching. Escrow: R650.
escrowGuarantee: Escrow released after visit report and mother confirmation.
pirbStandard: SANC Registered Midwife & Neonatal Nursing Specialist.

articleSections.heading: Infant Growth Tracking
articleSections.body: Digital scales record weight gain curves against WHO infant growth benchmarks.

articleSections.heading: Latching Coaching
articleSections.body: Hands-on lactation guidance helps mothers achieve comfortable, effective feeding positions.

title: Compassionate Palliative & Chronic Illness Nursing
subtitle: Specialized home palliative care providing comfort, dignity, and pain management
author: Bouul Health Team
problemHeadline: Managing chronic pain and terminal illness at home requires specialized clinical empathy
problemBody: Families carrying the emotional and physical burden of palliative care need qualified nursing relief.
bouulSolution: Compassionate palliative nurses providing pain control, oxygen therapy, and personal hygiene
Close coordination with attending hospices and treating oncologists
Escrow protected daily or overnight shift coverage
aiPromptExample: Request palliative nurse: 'Overnight nursing support for terminally ill patient at home.'
aiDiagnosisOutput: Shift: 19:00 to 07:00 (12h Night). Care: Comfort positioning, pain med log, airway clearance. Escrow: R1,800.
escrowGuarantee: Escrow released daily after family shift confirmation.
pirbStandard: SANC Palliative Care Certified & HPCSA Code of Conduct.

articleSections.heading: Pain & Symptom Management
articleSections.body: Nurses utilize standardized pain scales to administer prescribed analgesia promptly.

articleSections.heading: Family Respite Support
articleSections.body: Overnight nursing gives family caregivers peace of mind and essential rest.

title: Comprehensive Home Health & Vital Screening
subtitle: Mobile health assessments including blood pressure, cholesterol, glucose, and ECG
author: Bouul Health Team
problemHeadline: Busy schedules or mobility constraints cause people to delay routine health checkups
problemBody: Undiagnosed hypertension or elevated blood sugar often leads to sudden medical crises.
bouulSolution: Mobile nurse arrives with diagnostic equipment to run full health screening at home
Includes BP, blood glucose, cholesterol finger-prick, and BMI evaluation
Digital health report generated immediately for your records
aiPromptExample: Book home screening: 'Mobile health check for elderly parents at home.'
aiDiagnosisOutput: Screening Package: Full Vitals + Glucose + Lipid Panel. Report: Delivered in-app. Escrow: R500.
escrowGuarantee: Escrow released once digital health report is delivered to your app inbox.
pirbStandard: SANC Registered Nurse & Primary Health Screening Standard.

articleSections.heading: Point-of-Care Testing
articleSections.body: Instant blood results provide immediate clarity on blood sugar and lipid numbers.

articleSections.heading: GP Referral Routing
articleSections.body: Abnormal findings trigger automated summary reports formatted for your GP.
